mission.goal: Implement consequential remaining functional gaps after reading the comprehensive plan and Beads; commit meaningful increments directly to main through GitHub without PRs.
requirement_scope: FSS-139 native model compatibility and executor semantics
FSS-142 tiled CPU kernels with scalar semantics

implementation_checkpoints.change: ONNX vector/vector, vector/matrix and matrix/vector products through exact frozen reshapes and MatMul.
Bounded 4x8 output tiles for native broadcast MatMul, preserving each scalar reduction order.
Native, retained-custody and immutable CLI Matroska presentation selection with conservative HEVC prerequisites.
Larger and multidimensional constant Gather indices, preserved shape-control bounds, integration cases and scoped verification record.

authority.user: Implement and commit directly to main using GitHub; no PRs.
authority.scope: Repository source, deterministic fixtures and test execution only. No live-device, credential, remote camera or alert operation.
authority.publication: Expected-parent non-force GitHub main updates. New immutable blobs/trees/commits may precede ref publication when API rate limiting intervenes.
authority.release: Repository-owned qualification and retained local DSR evidence remain required; hosted Actions are supplementary.

cases.finding: Native MatMul operates on matrices but ONNX vector promotion was absent.
cases.resolution: Promote only vector operands with existing Reshape, execute native MatMul, and remove only the introduced dimensions. Existing matrix graph bytes remain unchanged.

cases.finding: The optimized executor tiled Conv but routed every MatMul node through the scalar reference.
cases.resolution: Prepare broadcast strides and checked products once, then execute independent 4x8 accumulator tiles with the exact ordered reduction and bounded cancellation. Runtime attention operands are admitted.

cases.finding: F32 Gather accepted only small scalar/vector INT64 controls, rejecting larger and multidimensional selections.
cases.resolution: Admit bounded static index tensors, coalesce ascending runs, preserve the full output index shape, and enforce byte, node, tensor and work ceilings. Other shape-control profiles remain narrow.

cases.finding: Matroska import retained source frames and timestamps but lacked a presentation selector and operator command.
cases.resolution: Track timing separately from historical manifests; authenticate the original and index, select intervals with explicit duration provenance and uncertainty, then release only after final custody validation.

cases.finding: Independent byte inspection found the checked-in HEVC sample 5 at 728 ms is leading RASL after CRA sample 3. Starting at CRA would omit prerequisites or suppress that picture.
cases.resolution: Retain the earlier declared IDR across CRA. HEVC IDR types 19/20 may begin spans; BLA types 16–18 clears the prerequisite until a later IDR. Add real-fixture and CRC-resealed BLA regressions.

findings: ONNX dot products produce scalar outputs and preserve pre-existing singleton/batch dimensions; helpers create no new arithmetic operator or generated weight.

Tiled MatMul uses no reassociation, explicit fused multiply-add, synthetic padding arithmetic, new thread or foreign library. Non-NaN differential assertions compare exact F32 bits; NaN classification is compared without portable payload claims.
Gather preserves repeated/negative indices and exact sample copies. A contiguous 4,096-index selection needs one Slice; separate runs are bounded by the 512-node budget.
Generated native Concat permits more than 256 inputs under graph bounds; the 256-input ceiling belongs to source ONNX node parsing.
Matroska selection returns metadata, source ranges and coding prerequisites. It does not export a clip, alter sentinel selection, infer UTC/capture time or certify physical absence.
Historical native graph/operator identities and Matroska import metadata encodings remain unchanged. Source-bound importer/kernel generation identities change to reflect implementation changes.
The shared constant-parser change is accompanied by execution of existing Model IR library/control tests in the repository's focused ONNX check script.

budgets.onnx: Original limits remain authoritative:16 MiB source/aggregate controls,64 MiB per tensor,512 nodes,4,096 names,rank ≤ 8 and cumulative deterministic import work. Empty/dynamic Gather indices remain unsupported.
budgets.matmul: Existing cumulative logical tensor-byte and MAC budgets/liveness remain in force. 32 independent F32 accumulators add 128 bytes of reported scratch; cancellation at most 256 reduction terms per output cell between checks. Scratch is payload accounting, not RSS.
budgets.matroska: Complete original admitted before allocation, at most 512 MiB. Selection defaults:16,777,216 work units,262,144 aggregate result rows,65,536 decode samples,128 MiB decode bytes. Immutable CLI reads and final revalidation share one allowance.

validation.local_execution_blocker: Baseline test code generation was killed for memory use. The execution environment subsequently became unavailable. No changed-code local compile, rustfmt or test execution was obtained.

Cross-file retained/CLI review of source authentication, complete-original admission, immutable writer coexistence, cumulative reads and final revalidation.
Independent real AVC/HEVC fixture inspection checked timestamps, keyframe/NAL types and the CRA/RASL prerequisite defect.
Reconstructed final source strings match independently computed SHA256 digests; manifest hashing verified against empty/abc/million-a vectors and existing repository source hashes.
required_followup_commands: Run scoped rustfmt and repository-owned manifest/qualification checks before promotion.

invalidations: Earlier passing execution does not validate later source changes; source review and blob integrity are not runtime evidence.
Hosted targeted success does not override the failing broader policy gate or establish local release qualification.
Matroska gaps and unknown frame ends cannot establish scene absence, capture time or live continuity.
No performance speedup follows until paired same-binary measurements are retained.

obligations.task: Compile and execute the latest kernel, Gather, Matroska and CLI tests on the pinned dependency closure, then fix any concrete failures.
Run the same-binary release benchmark and retain output equality, timings and cost observations before making a speedup claim.
Keep broad feature Beads and release qualification open; existing dependency/registry/schema/domain drift remains a separate owner decision.

unknowns: Latest changed-code compilation, runtime behavior and formatting remain unverified until actual executions are observed.

Matroska CRA-only/BLA-only starts, nonunit track scale, nonzero offset/seek-preroll/discard-padding, duplicate PTS and incomplete originals are outside the explicit temporal profile.
